title: DNA Extraction Using Qiagen MagAttract HMW DNA Kit
author: Murray Grant
materials: Ensure that 96 - 100 % ethanol is added to buffers MW1 and PE.

Gently resuspend the bacterial pellet in 180 μl Buffer ATL using a cut tip as the resuspension will be viscous. Transfer the resuspended sample to a 1.5 ml tubes with a cut tip. Add 20 μl Proteinase K and incubate for 30mins in the Thermomixer at 56°C shaking at 900 rpm.

steps.title: Heat mixer for lysis
steps.instruction: Set the Thermomixer (or equivalent) to 56 °C and allow it to reach temperature before starting the lysis step.

steps.title: Dissolve ATL precipitate (if needed)
steps.instruction: If a precipitate is observed in Buffer ATL, incubate the tube at 37 °C with occasional shaking until the precipitate dissolves.

steps.title: Resuspend magnetic particles
steps.instruction: Vortex the vessel containing the magnetic particles vigorously for at least 3 min to ensure full resuspension before first use.

steps.title: Add RNase A and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 4 μl RNase A to the sample, flick the tube several times to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Add MagAttract G and Buffer MB
steps.instruction: Resuspend the MagAttract Suspension G by vortexing, then add 15 μl MagAttract Suspension G and 280 μl Buffer MB to the sample; mix by pulse vortexing.

steps.title: Incubate mixture 3 min
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the Thermomixer and incubate at room temperature for 3 min at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Magnetic separation and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the tubes to a magnetic rack, wait ~1 min until beads collect, then carefully aspirate and discard all supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.

steps.title: First MW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 μl Buffer MW1 to the bead pellet, flick to mix, place tubes in the Thermomixer, and incubate at room temperature for 1 min at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Separate beads after MW1
steps.instruction: Place tubes back on the magnetic rack, wait ~1 min, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second MW1 wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the MW1 wash: add 700 μl Buffer MW1, mix, incubate 1 min at 1400 rpm, magnetic separation, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: First PE wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 μl Buffer PE to the bead pellet, flick to mix, incubate in the Thermomixer at room temperature for 1 min at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Separate beads after PE
steps.instruction: Place tubes on the magnetic rack, wait ~1 min, then remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Second PE wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the PE wash: add 700 μl Buffer PE, mix, incubate 1 min at 1400 rpm, magnetic separation, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Remove residual wash buffer
steps.instruction: While tubes remain in the magnetic rack, use a small pipette tip to aspirate any remaining supernatant or buffer traces from the tube and lid.

steps.title: First water rinse
steps.instruction: With tubes still on the magnetic rack, pipette 700 μl nuclease‑free water onto the side opposite the bead pellet, incubate at room temperature for 1 min, then carefully remove and discard the water without touching the bead pellet.

steps.title: Second water rinse
steps.instruction: Repeat the water rinse step.

steps.title: Elution incubation (150 μl)
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack, add 150 μl distilled water, flick to mix, place tubes in the Thermomixer, and incubate at room temperature for 3 min at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Return tubes to the magnetic rack, wait ~1 min for bead collection, then transfer the supernatant (containing high‑molecular‑weight DNA) with a cut tip to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Second elution (100 μl)
steps.instruction: Take the beads out of the magnetic rack, add 100 μl distilled pure water, flick to mix, and incubate at 60 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Post‑elution incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in the Thermomixer and incubate at room temperature for 3 min at 1400 rpm (repeat as instructed).
